blocks.x: Applied AI & GenAI applied to National Government & Digital Services. This page sets out the operating context, the delivery pattern we run, the services and platforms involved, and the outcomes we commit to.

National digital government builds shared rails — identity, data exchange, notification, payments — and industrializes citizen services on top. Success is measured in take-up, resolution and trust; failure modes are silos, legacy cores and unaccountable AI.

items: Assistive AI deployed without transparency/oversight frameworks.
Citizens re-submit facts; fraud/error hide at seams.

blocks.x: The pattern composes RAG & Enterprise Knowledge Systems, AI Proof-of-Concept & Value Validation, RAG & Enterprise Knowledge Systems from the Applied AI & Generative AI tower, wired into the unit's workflows (Citizen service delivery, Benefits/licensing casework, Interagency data exchange) on Dataq Compass and Dataq Forge and Dataq Nexus. Governance inherits the sector frame — GDPR/national privacy among others — with evidence generated by the delivery itself.

items: Replace hype with evidence: feasibility, value and adoption risk proven on your data in 6-10 weeks.
Align AI to P&L lines and risk mandates — a sequenced portfolio, not a pile of pilots.
One governed platform, many GenAI products: retrieval, guardrails and cost control as shared services.
Transparency notices + oversight gates per system (conformity documented)

blocks.x: At industry level, the same pattern

At Public Sector & Government level this capability reads as: grounded answers on entitlements and procedures across web and voice with citations (first-contact resolution up sharply). The sub-industry page narrows it to the unit's workflows, regimes and KPIs.

Programs run on a fixed rhythm so progress is visible from week one. Weeks 1–2 lock the baseline: the current metric is measured with your team and signed before build starts. Weeks 3–8 deliver the pilot on bounded scope — one decision path, one workflow, one plant or one portfolio — with a control owner named on your side. Weeks 9–12 industrialize what worked: runbooks, monitoring, enablement and a measured delta against the signed baseline. Anything that misses its gate is stopped or redirected with a documented decision, not quietly extended.
